capabilities: Run Claude Code, Codex, or Antigravity in a terminal tab
List, resume, and save sessions as notes
Start a session from any note or folder
Save turn-by-turn transcripts as Markdown notes
extras: Desktop and macOS only (Obsidian 1.13.1+). Enable on one computer at a time; sessions can't move between machines. Conversation view and vault setup are experimental. Never asks for an API key; sign-in and billing stay with the CLI. Scheduled tasks are Claude Code only and run only while Obsidian is open.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run CLI coding agents, and their sessions live outside the vault where they can't be linked or searched.
